The '''''Chancellor''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
The ''Chancellor'' was acquired by the Rebel Alliance sometime in or prior to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="EAW" /> Around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ''Chancellor'' was serving as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for the Alliance fleet. After many [[Renegade Flight]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were lost, a plaque commemorating their [[Death/Legends|casualties]] was hung in the crew lounge on the ''Chancellor's'' [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command deck]].<ref name="GG3" />
